## Clean up time, lat, lon columns
```{r}
# Ensure timestamps are interpreted as UTC.
# If time is already correctly parsed as POSIXct, leave it unchanged.
if (!inherits(par_df$time, "POSIXct")) {
  par_df$time <- as.POSIXct(
    par_df$time,
    format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
    tz = "UTC"
  )
}
# Convert character/factor coordinates to numeric safely.
to_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(as.character(x))))
}

# Clean and flag coordinates, preserving the original columns.
par_df <- par_df %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    lat_clean = to_numeric(lat),
    lon_clean = to_numeric(lon),

    coord_status = case_when(
      !is.finite(lat_clean) | !is.finite(lon_clean) ~
        "missing_or_non_numeric",

      abs(lat_clean) > 90 ~
        "invalid_latitude",

      lon_clean < -180 | lon_clean > 360 ~
        "invalid_longitude",

      lon_clean > 180 ~
        "longitude_converted_from_0_360",

      TRUE ~ "valid"
    ),

    # Only convert plausible 0–360-degree longitudes.
    lon_clean = if_else(
      is.finite(lon_clean) &
        lon_clean > 180 &
        lon_clean <= 360,
      lon_clean - 360,
      lon_clean
    ),

    coords_valid = coord_status %in% c(
      "valid",
      "longitude_converted_from_0_360"
    ),

    # Exclude unusable coordinate pairs from downstream calculations.
    lat_clean = if_else(coords_valid, lat_clean, NA_real_),
    lon_clean = if_else(coords_valid, lon_clean, NA_real_)
  )
```

## Loop through and recalculate PAR based on astronomical model
```{r}
# Calculate local times, solar zenith angles, and PAR.
par_df <- par_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Keep lookup failures from stopping the entire loop
    tz_local = if (!coords_valid || is.na(time)) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      tryCatch(
        tz_lookup_coords(
          lat = lat_clean,
          lon = lon_clean,
          method = "fast",
          warn = FALSE
        ),
        error = function(e) NA_character_
      )
    },
    # get local date from time zone
    date_local = if (is.na(tz_local)) {
      as.Date(NA_character_)
    } else {
      as.Date(time, tz = tz_local)
    },
  # get local time from time zone
    time_local = if (is.na(tz_local)) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      format(
        time,
        format = "%H:%M:%S",
        tz = tz_local
      )
    },
    # calculate sun zenith angle from local date and time
    sza = if (is.na(tz_local)) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      solar_zenith_angle_piCurve(
        date = date_local,
        time = time_local,
        latitude = lat_clean,
        longitude = lon_clean
      )
    },
    # check zenith angle is valid for calculating surface PAR
    sat_par = if (!is.finite(sza)) { # not nan
      NA_real_
    } else if (sza >= 90) { # not night
      0
    } else { # calculate PAR
      result <- PAR_sea_surface_piCurve(
        zenith_angle = sza,
        database_info = GreggCarder1990,
        sample_date = date_local,
        units = "umol photons m^-2 s^-1" # same units as ship radiometer
      )
      # save into dataframe
      as.numeric(result$PAR[1])
    },
    # report status of calculation
    calculation_status = case_when(
      !coords_valid ~ "invalid_coordinates",
      is.na(time) ~ "missing_or_invalid_time",
      is.na(tz_local) ~ "timezone_lookup_failed",
      !is.finite(sza) ~ "invalid_solar_zenith",
      !is.finite(sat_par) ~ "invalid_PAR",
      TRUE ~ "ok"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## plot distributions of satellite derived PAR + smoothed PAR
```{r}
library(patchwork)

# change from wide to long
par_long <- par_df %>%
  select(cruise, cruise_day, day_hour, sat_par, par_smooth) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(sat_par, par_smooth),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "PAR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = factor(
      variable,
      levels = c("sat_par", "par_smooth")
    )
  )

# Summarize observation counts and availability.
par_summary <- par_long %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_available = sum(!is.na(PAR)),
    n_missing = sum(is.na(PAR)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# calcualte proportion of available to total data
availability <- par_df %>%
  summarise(
    sat_par = sum(!is.na(sat_par)) / nrow(par_df),
    par_smooth = sum(!is.na(par_smooth)) / nrow(par_df)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = factor(
      variable,
      levels = c("sat_par", "par_smooth")
    ),
    label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1)
  )

par_colors <- c(
  sat_par = "#4477AA",
  par_smooth = "#EE9977"
)

# Panel A: non-missing observation counts.
p_counts <- ggplot(
  par_summary,
  aes(x = variable, y = n_available, fill = variable)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::comma(n_available)),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = par_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_comma(),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Observation counts",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total observations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Panel B: available versus missing percentages.
p_availability <- ggplot(
  availability,
  aes(x = variable, y = proportion, fill = variable)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = par_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Data availability",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of all rows"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Panel C: distributions of non-missing values.
p_box <- ggplot(
  filter(par_long, !is.na(PAR)),
  aes(x = variable, y = PAR, fill = variable)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.alpha = 0.2,
    outlier.size = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = par_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "PAR distributions",
    x = NULL,
    y = "PAR (µmol photons / m2 / s-1"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Combine panels A, B, and C.
combined_plot <- (
  p_counts + p_availability + p_box
) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

combined_plot
```

## Plot distributions of PAR data for 1 cruise (Diel 2015)
```{r}
# only look at day time values (pro)
test_cruise <- 'CN11ID'
diel_cruise <- subset(par_df, (cruise == test_cruise 
                               & pop == 'prochloro'))


ggplot(
  filter(diel_cruise, !is.na(par_smooth)),
  aes(x = par_smooth, y = sat_par)
) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ cruise_day,
    ncol = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = glue("PAR distributions by cruise day: {cruise}"),
    x = "PAR",
    y = "Number of observations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

## subset diel cruise long format
diel_cruise_long <- subset(par_long, (cruise == test_cruise))
# drop duplicates
uniq_long <- diel_cruise_long %>% 
  distinct(cruise, cruise_day, day_hour, .keep_all = TRUE)
ggplot(
  filter(diel_cruise_long,),
  aes(x = day_hour, y = PAR, colour = variable)
) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ cruise_day,
    ncol = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = glue("PAR distributions by cruise day: {test_cruise}"),
    x = "PAR",
    y = "Number of observations"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```
